approved_scope.category_description: conventional leave-on hair-conditioning products (spray, mist, milk, lotion, cream, microemulsion, two-phase)

reviewed_anchor_patterns.purpose: T19 reading (b): a film-led architecture with no leg above the tail marker is directional neutrality, not an abstention
T16: an implausible tail marker may not disqualify a route; the gold set's only exercised `medium` row
T15: a conditioning film with a supporting fixative is in-category with `hold_support: incidental`; the §2.3.2/§7.7 worked example

locked_interpretation.care_direction: Product formula direction only; never a diagnosis of a user's protein or moisture deficiency. `balanced` carries two explicitly co-equal readings: a substantive mixed protein-plus-moisture architecture, and directional neutrality on a film-led architecture (T19). `unknown` is reserved for genuine evidence failure.
locked_interpretation.repair_support_level: Comparative temporary damage-support potential only. `low` is ordinary conditioning and explicitly includes bond-claim-only products; `medium` requires a qualifying R2 film route above the tail marker with conditioning_level >= moderate; `high` requires exact-product repair evidence at E3+. No value proves structural repair.
locked_interpretation.heat_protection: Production carries a binary `provides_heat_protection`, claim-led with a formula sanity-check against the closed L9 evidenced-polymer list. Strength and temperature are never graded; `heat_protection_max_c` is not part of this model.
locked_interpretation.conservative_failure_invariant: §1.1: every hard rule must fail toward human review or toward the anchor's own conservative value, never toward a recommendation or a more favourable reading than the evidence supports.
locked_interpretation.evidence_ceiling: Formula-only conclusions remain E2 and cannot establish finished-product performance. Claims are E0 and never create efficacy.
locked_interpretation.research_uncertainty: Counter-signals, confidence bands and reading conventions stay inside the research trace (G14) and never reach a projected field or a user-facing surface.

validation_basis.promotion_note: v1.0 promotes the v0.4 draft unchanged. No anchor, threshold, enumeration, gate, projection, evidence bar or string was edited by the promotion; only version identity, lock status and the research-envelope promotion-at-lock stamp.
validation_basis.lane_design: two independent sealed lanes, frozen packet only, no web, seal confirmation required
residue_classes_closed: two packet evidence gaps (product_form slots 2/6/9/10; application_stage slot 9) closed by an evidence pass and an identical amendment to both packets
one text defect (§8.4's false LAYER aside) corrected in ledger row 20a
one clarifying sentence (§10.2.1 binds focus.secondary), one §18 emission-scope paragraph, four §14 canonical trigger ids

unseen_product_test.note: two sealed lanes agreed on every value on five of six products; the sixth was a three-way same-market formula-source conflict that became ruling T18

known_limits_retained: The `repair_support_level` `medium` row is exercised by exactly one gold-set record (Redken, via T16) and the `high` row is E3+ and unobserved.
T19's film-led `balanced` row has been exercised on exactly one record (EVO); reading (a), the substantive mixed architecture, is taken by no record in the set.

T7's `manufacturer_hold_level`, T14's cross-market claim exception beyond its single record, T17's H3 and H8 triggers, and both tiers of T18 are implemented but not calibrated by two independent lanes.
The tail-marker rank convention is a reading convention, never a measurement; its variance across list lengths stays an open gap (§17.14, §17.18).
Every §17 open evidence gap stays open under v1.0; a gap is not closed by removing the field that exposed it.
Actual leave-on residue, transfer and accumulation remain unmeasured for every untested product; dose is a hidden variable the model does not score.

conditioner_relationship (replacement_capable | booster_only) has no dimension behind it
eligibility emission for excluded records, which emit no lean profile (§2.3.1)
